The '''"Versatility" Outfit''' was a model of [[Holographic Costume]] produced by [[Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles/Legends|Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The "Versatility" Outfit was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
